description: A single accuracy-evaluation table rendered as an image — no axes, micrograph, scale bar, colour map or legend are present, and there are no lettered sub-panels. The table has three numeric columns headed "RMSE", "R²" (printed as italic R with superscript 2) and "AARE", and three data rows. Row 1, "Flow stress (varying conditions)", reads RMSE = 3.3118 MPa, R² = 0.9589, AARE = 4.57 %. Row 2, "AGS (varying conditions)", reads RMSE = 4.0169 μm, R² = 0.9777, AARE = 4.11 %. Row 3, "DRX fraction (varying conditions)", reads RMSE = 0.0229, R² = 0.9784, AARE = 2.47 %. The RMSE unit therefore changes from row to row — MPa for flow stress, μm for AGS, and no unit for the dimensionless DRX fraction. All three rows refer to "varying conditions". The table demonstrates that the 3D cellular automaton predictions of flow stress, austenite grain size and DRX fraction agree closely with the reference data: every R² is above 0.95 and every AARE is below 5 %.

No other panel is present in the group.

Row 'AGS (varying conditions)' lists RMSE = 4.0169 μm, R² = 0.9777 and AARE = 4.11 %.
Row 'DRX fraction (varying conditions)' lists RMSE = 0.0229, R² = 0.9784 and AARE = 2.47 %.
The RMSE column carries different units per row: MPa for flow stress, μm for AGS, and no unit for the dimensionless DRX fraction.
The largest R² value in the table is 0.9784 (DRX fraction) and the smallest is 0.9589 (flow stress); all three R² values are above 0.95.
The smallest AARE in the table is 2.47 % (DRX fraction) and the largest is 4.57 % (flow stress); all three AARE values are below 5 %.
Every row label carries the qualifier 'varying conditions', i.e. the accuracy metrics are reported for varying deformation conditions rather than a single constant condition.
The caption states that the table is the accuracy evaluation of flow stress, AGS and DRX fraction predicted using 3D CA under varying deformation conditions.
The caption asserts that the quantities being validated are the 3D cellular automaton (CA) model predictions, which the table itself does not state — the table only gives metric names and values.
